company.name: SkyPtoP
company.shortDescription: SkyPtoP Mobile App for iOS and Android is worldwide delivery of parcels via fellow-travellers. Online payment after order fulfillment.
company.description:
SkyPtoP service is worldwide delivery of parcels via fellow-travellers. Thousands of people, ready to help for reasonable price, are already right in your phone. SkyP2P service is the simplest and most reliable way of parcel delivery. Just download SkyPtoP mobile app, specify the route and choose the best fellow-traveller among the approved ones to deliver your parcel. Fellow-traveller will be paid only after confirmation of that the parcel has been received.
SkyPtoP service allows both senders to make delivery cheaper, faster and simpler and travellers to offset the costs on their own trip.  Just join SkyPtoP network of approved fellow-travellers and enjoy the opportunity to earn money while helping people. Project launch: October 2021.
Initial project: SkyShift`s - door-to-door delivery and storage of sports equipment, luggage and parcels for travelling light. Project launch: August 2019.

productsAndServices.description: A mobile app for iOS and Android enabling users to send and receive parcels worldwide via fellow travelers with payment after delivery.
productsAndServices.name: SkyPtoP Mobile Application
